copy.local_saves_description: Your room, outfits, coins and progress are saved locally for offline play. Linked partners also share their room and progress through Duette Arcade.
copy.reduce_motion_description: Use calmer camera and screen transitions.
copy.touch_guide: Tap the floor to walk or a cabinet to play. Pinch to zoom, then drag one finger to look around. In Decorate, hold and drag furniture, then release to save; use two fingers to move the view.
copy.updates_description: Content updates download in the background and appear after you fully close and reopen the app.
